messages:
Elise (product): Quick sync request — we have two enterprise asks that collide: ACME wants transferability of reserved credits between projects, Beacon wants guaranteed regional burst windows. Need to decide scope for H2 reserved-pools roadmap.
Vikram (eng-runtime): Can we solve both with a single primitive? 'reserve-transfer' + region-scoped burst reservations. Implementation risk is minor for bookkeeping but big for billing and SLO semantics.
Marc (eng-platform): Billing is the hairy part. Transfers imply mutating a customer's reserved bucket. We need audit trails, idempotent ops, and RBAC. Also need a rate-limit on transfers to avoid quota gaming.
Nora (sales): ACME will push if we don't offer cross-project credits. Beacon will accept regional guarantees if we provide clear SLA language. Both are revenue catalysts.
Talia (oncall): Operationally, regional burst windows + transfers change admission logic. Oncall needs deterministic fallthrough rules when a donor pool is drained mid-burst. We should avoid surprise evictions.
Elise (product): Proposal: MVP = transfer API (explicit, logged, owner-confirmed) + soft regional burst guarantees (booked headroom + prewarm). Hard guarantees postponed to dedicated SLA tier. Thoughts?
Vikram (eng-runtime): Agree on soft guarantees for MVP. Technical checklist: 1) transfer API endpoint + async job, 2) transfer ledger + audit events, 3) admission check updated to consult donor/recipient pools, 4) fallback policy when transfer fails.
Marc (eng-platform): I'll draft RBAC + audit model. Also add a small throttling token bucket per-customer to limit transfer churn.
Talia (oncall): For fallback policy, propose ordering: recipient reserved bucket -> local soft headroom -> global spillover -> degrade to best-effort. Documented and observable.
Elise (product): Good. Launch criteria I'm thinking: a) E2E transfer flow tested, b) admission fallback behaves deterministically under congestion, c) billing records for transfers reconciled in nightly job, d) legal approves contract language for 'soft guarantees'.
Nora (sales): Add: sample SLA wording and an FAQ for customers about how transfers affect latency SLAs. I'll draft customer-facing docs once legal gives the thumbs up.
Vikram (eng-runtime): Quick config stub for the transfer policy (wip):
```yaml
reserve_transfer:
  enabled: true
  max_transfers_per_day: 5
  require_owner_confirmation: true
  throttle_bucket_size: 10
```
Vikram (eng-runtime): Also we should emit events: `transfer.requested`, `transfer.completed`, `transfer.failed` with `reason` tag. That will make debugging and billing joins simpler.
Marc (eng-platform): Deploy plan: feature-flagged API + migration job to backfill a transfer ledger for existing pools. Add telemetry dashboards for transfer success/fail rates and resulting occupancy shifts.
Talia (oncall): Oncall runbook items: how to detect a stuck transfer job, how to force-rollback, and how to implement emergency revocation if a donor pool is abused.
Elise (product): Prioritization: is this workplan a must-have for H2 GA of reserved pools or a follow-up? We have limited cycles.
Nora (sales): From the pipeline: ACME deal likely to close if transfer exists before Q3. Beacon is flexible. Recommend prioritizing transfer API first.
Vikram (eng-runtime): Estimate: transfer API + ledger + admission changes = 3 sprints (2 eng + 1 stabilization). Soft burst windowing and prewarm mechanics = additional 2 sprints. Can parallelize some pieces.
Marc (eng-platform): Platform work (billing/reconciliation + RBAC) = 1.5 sprints. We'll need a short legal review cycle for T&Cs.
Elise (product): Decision: prioritize transfer API and ledger in next sprint; put soft regional burst work as parallel follow-on but gate GA on e2e telemetry and legal signoff. Assign owners: Vikram (runtime lead), Marc (platform lead), Talia (oncall docs), Nora (customer comms).
Vikram (eng-runtime): I'll open the RFC + implementation PR tomorrow and include the YAML config into the repo.
Marc (eng-platform): I'll stub the billing reconciliation job and the RBAC policy in a branch.
Talia (oncall): I'll draft the emergency runbook and test scenarios we should run during canary.
Nora (sales): I'll coordinate ACME expectation-setting this week.
DeployBot: CI for `reserve-transfer` branch passed: all tests green :white_check_mark: (build 4123).
Elise (product): Awesome. Follow-ups: 1) Marc/Vikram sync on event schema, 2) Legal review request by EOD Friday, 3) Add transfer success/failure to the Console's per-tenant timeline.
Vikram (eng-runtime): Noted. I'll add the event schema proposal to the RFC.
Marc (eng-platform): Will ping legal. Also opening a dashboard ticket for occupancy delta by transfer.
Elise (product): Thanks everyone — I'll capture this as the H2 reserved-pools milestone with owners and launch criteria. :rocket:
Nora (sales): :thumbsup:
Talia (oncall): :cool:
